## Problem and scope

Explain the problem, intended behavior and owning module. Link an issue when applicable.

## Changes

Describe implementation, API/type/example updates and any compatibility or dataset implications.

## Verification

List exact commands, outcomes and environment. Clearly identify checks not run.
For runtime/ABI/integration changes, identify the current-source extensive report rather than an old bundled runtime result.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Regression expectations are independent of the changed implementation.
- [ ] Domain rules remain in Rust; module dependency directions are preserved.
- [ ] Public types and documentation match behavior and limitations.
- [ ] New rules/data have authoritative sources, provenance and reuse evidence.
- [ ] Missing/ambiguous/unknown results and requested constraints are preserved.
- [ ] No real personal data, credentials, private reports or local tooling/session files are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices and immutable archives are preserved where relevant.
